changelog:
- Added in-app update prompt that checks GitHub for new versions
- Score/size decoupled: food +1 score +1 growth, trail +1 score no growth, boss hit +5 score -3 shrink, boss defeat +25 score +5 growth
- Boss trappable: avoids snake on move, teleports only off snake
- Live color preview in settings
- 3 camera modes: CLASSIC_ZOOM, FULL_PLAY_AREA, FIT_VERTICAL
- Camera centering fix for full-board modes
